Feather-light polish wave — reworked upload options, fixed image/PDF preview, and resolved the `BASE_URL` share-link bug.

## Fixed

- **Image/PDF preview reliability.** Three-layer fix for the preview never appearing on the download page:
  1. **Null MIME in the DB** (when the browser sends no `filetype` in the tus upload) caused `canPreview = false` so the preview box was never rendered. The client now infers the content type from the revealed filename extension as a fallback (`lib/mime.ts`); the server does the same for `wantInline` and the inline `Content-Type`. Old files without a stored MIME now preview correctly without a re-upload.
  2. **Inline GET failed behind a reverse proxy.** The auth cookie was not reliably reaching the image request in some proxy configurations. The per-file link key (already in the URL fragment) is now also passed as `?k=` on the `?inline=1` / unlimited-share path, eliminating the cookie dependency for the preview.
  3. **Preview frame collapsed** to 0 height on a load failure. Added `minHeight` and flexbox centering so the box is always visible.
- **`BASE_URL` now applies to generated share links** (#1). The share URL was built from the browser's `window.location.origin`, so behind a reverse proxy the link used the internal address instead of the public domain. `BASE_URL` is now resolved server-side and passed to the client via `ServerConfigProvider` (the same pattern as `BrandingProvider`), and used for the link — falling back to the browser origin only when unset.
- **Lint CI green** — removed the obsolete `XML Template Lint` job. The Unraid template now lives in the central templates repo (validated there); the job was failing trying to lint missing files.

## Changed

- **Reworked upload options panel.** Expiry is now an on/off toggle (off = never expires) like the download limit. Order: expiry → download limit → password. The divider above the upload button was removed.
- **"Download options" heading** (`settings.title`) renamed from "Share options" across all 26 languages.
- **German grammar** — expiry labels now read "7 Tagen" / "30 Tagen" (dative case).
- **"Feather-light" wording** in the short description across the GitHub repo description, README, Unraid template, and the templates-repo card.
